versions.changelog:
- Expanded skill description to include multiple languages (Chinese, German, Japanese, Spanish) and common search terms for trade show budgeting and ROI.
- No workflow or budget methodology changes—core planning steps remain the same.
- Improved discoverability for international and multilingual users.
- Clarified the skill’s trigger phrases and intended use cases.
Sharpened skill descriptions and first-screen README summaries for clearer ClawHub discovery, faster fit assessment, and stronger install intent.
Workflow and handoff refinements across pre-show, on-site, and post-show skills. Improved trigger boundaries, decision-oriented outputs, and cross-skill next-step guidance.

Initial release: Trade Show Budget Planner

- Generate detailed, realistic trade show budgets using industry cost benchmarks.
- Supports exhibitors, sponsors, and attendee-only participation types.
- Includes ROI projection models with customizable assumptions and sensitivity analysis.
- Provides optimization suggestions based on user-provided constraints and best practices.
- Offers multiple export formats: markdown table, CSV, and executive summary.
- Integrates checklists for confirming venue services and budget items.
- Includes helpful cost estimation rules and contingencies.
